title: How to let computers recognize objects?
reading: The slide poses object recognition as an agent problem: a machine perceives an image and must act by naming the object class. A photo of a tabby cat, a percept/action cycle diagram, and a robot deliberating among candidate labels illustrate the framing.

visuals.description: Photograph of a tabby cat lying on a floor, used as the input image.
Yellow circular two-arrow cycle labelled above 'Percept: See a picture' and below 'Action: Tell the object class: a cat!', beside a robot icon with a thought bubble reading 'A cat? A lion? A car?'
visuals.assertion: Object recognition is an agent loop: the percept is an image, the action is outputting a class label chosen among candidate categories.

concepts.name: Percept–action agent framing
concepts.why_it_matters: Casts recognition as an agent mapping sensory input to a decision.

concepts.name: Object class / image classification
concepts.why_it_matters: The output space of the recognition task.
